      "score": 0.35,

      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "label IPC, updates the libmultiprocess subtree, and implements Windows process management and socket primitives in src/ipc.",

      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Extends IPC platform coverage to Windows by replacing POSIX-specific primitives, directly addressing libmultiprocess issues #53 and #114 and unblocking Windows multiprocess execution (#28722)."
    },

      "name": "mining",
